book.name: Lukasarini
book.title: Lukasarini kuku Nuw Lukasi yuwaa Isus ashirangu anoo kamanchinllpa

content: Mishat, yuwaa Isus Apanllpat tsiyatamaam yusur tayaspatarangu anoo na kamanchinllpa
Isussha waanaatsi wipunashi tayaspataku, Uru Apanllpat tsiyatangtsa; sambaytarintspa, mang, tárangiya. Tsiyatssis na kamanchintspa mangeetsis p'tsimaama, tárangu;
Sirútamasa kurak k'kuzee yaramapan taarangiya, mang tárangiya Isusu. An tputs watseenurimuncha. Apanllee nda chinarangiya. Tputsee chinarangitamtaja.
Mashindsha mang: Ichee, istanda, watam tputs nuwaa kiyung yachakandanawa; táyaru, kapung tamundarangiya kurakaatsi.

Kuraksha istamaam mangu ngatku, mashindsha putam antam: Istanda; tát, putam antam: Istanda; tát ashku, tamundarangiya. Ashiriya, zapishsha kurak mangush chinayaru, ¿Tamacheezi? tárangiya. Nduntaa Apanllee chinakuri, nduntaa tputsee chinakuri,
ashiritaa mashindoo istachparina. Ndunnaa istakuri, uwsha kapung tamundat tamundat ashkachu, nuwsha kiyung kachiyachparina kizpuri. Ashiri istachima, tárangiya kuraka watseenuritaata.
Ashiri mazinangtsa, tárangiya Isusu. ¿Kurak amaranga? yutarittaati, kizaa istachima, watam nda sambaytaranguwa, mang, tárangiya.
Itaru, nuwsha siyaa atashina; Apanllinashapa aranginasha waanaatsi tiptsir istachiya, ndunnaa sambaytaksina. Apanll zapshtacheeja, ndambaree.

Izuuru tapachindachiya tiptsireetsiya. Mikeeru kusachparee wanimaama. Ashiritaa, nuw wanimaam kuskachuri, ¿nitaati nuw ichingurooja tputs mangoonaru anush kuschi? Machinawaam mangoonam pangchina, mang tárangiya Isusu, wipunashee tayaspataku.

Isussha minootssha tputs tayaspatarangitamta. An tputs waantari mangush chinaku, tárangana; Apanllee mangoonaktanicha, mangu, tárangana. Tsiyatssis mangeetsis p'tsimaam kamanchintspa; mang, tárangiya Isusu.
Tsimbun tputs Apanllpat tsiyatamaam naateersin, Apanllish pang', Irusarinushparee pshturangana. Min tputs Parísiypanshuchimuncha; minsha tputs gobernoo urkir yampanimuncha.

Parísiypanshuchsha tputs chiyzayaru, mangshuri Apaa, nuw tputs tamakpari ashkeezi, nda. Nuw shuchikeezi, Apaa. Nuw nda maachtangaz támaraki. Nuw kizaa yutarit patatkeezi, Apaa. Nitaati anpat tputs, gobernoo urkir yampanpata tputs nuw waritakeezi, nda.
Apaa, shiyamand kaminish minamtash domingo uru mangukina tsimbun zari. Mishat, tarawaztakuri, kurikee 10 putayaruri, uru shiyaam minamtam wayakinawa; tárangiya.

Itarshacha, gobernoo urkir yampan uru washchirimuncha; pazirangiya. Arap xiyeeru, timucheeru, tsiyatarangiya. Mang' mantsatsaw titkuree tuzimku, tiyam tiyam ántar ashirangiya. Uwsha tsiyatku: Apaa, nuwaa istangandama. Nuw kizpur yutarittana. Mangeetsi yaranda; táyaru, naatarangiya.

Ashiriya, nuwsha siyaa atashina; mang, tárangu Isusu. Apanll anoo tputs istarangiya. Yutaritshishirineetsi tachingarangiya. Apanlleem uru ashtariya. Tputs waanaatsi ungirtakachu, Apanllsha nda istachiya. Itaru, tputs Apanllee istanda tákchu, Apanllsha kapung istachiya; mang, tárangiya Isusu. Yuwaa Isus Apanllpat tsiyatamaam tayaspataku, tárangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus nlluraa chinarangu anoo kamanchinllpa
Minushsha zari tputs, Isus ipareetsi much patatpanda atusin, kanxoo zapan mang yushindarangana. Itaru, Isussha wipunash: Watsta; Isusoo tamundarintspa; mang, tárangana tputseetsi.

Itaru, Isussha: Watsta tárinllpa; pchindintspa, tárangiya. Isussha nlluraa much patateeru, Apanllpat tsiyata ashirangiya. Sheeru, tputsee waneerangiya. Tputs nllurpaz ashiru nuwaa chinaku, anoo Apanll kizpur chinakiya. Ancha Apanll tiptsiri.
Ashiri mazinantsa nuwaa kuki. Tputs ndunnaa nllur tamapari ashiru Apanllee chinaku, ayamtaati Apanllish pshtucheeja, ndambaree; mang, tárangiya Isusu. Yuwaa Isus nlluraa chinataru anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus: Apanllish pshtumaam mbamcha, tárangu anoo kamanchinllpa

Anpurtam kuraksha tsipas Isusoo mang tsiyatarangiya. Ichee, shiy wanasirtishcha. Ashiriya, Apanlleem taárash yasapi aturi, shiyash kusaramachtana. Ashiri kamaningandama: ¿taarashee urutarit payumaam tamaycheezi? táyaru,
Isussha: ¿Mayaamsha, shiy wanasirtishcha, nuwaa átsha? tárangu. Apanllimaritcha wanasiriya. Tputs minamtiyam anpata tatsamooreeja.
Itaru, shiy Apanllee kamachtamarini mangoonakpasha. Watam Apanll:

content.text: Mishat, Apareetsis wanasir ksutangtsa. Kuk payungtsa.

content: watam atuwa. ¿Tamarangsha anootsi? mang, tárangiya Isusu.
Kuraksha: Apanllee kamachtamarini ichinguru payukuri, anumunari wachinaranginawa, tárangiya.

Isussha mang anoo mazinayaru, Itaru, shiyaam minam arangeem wand pshatakiya; tárangu. Mazinangcha; maachiritaatsish paxanxeerush, tuchingeerush, pukireemsha panangcha. Sheerush, nuwash tchitangandama. Ashkachush, Apanllishsha shiyaam maachi pishtacheeja, ndambaree; mang, tárangiya.
Itaru, kuraksha an kurkirimuncha. Ashirucha, Isusoo kuk mazinayaru, ngateeru, mang' mantsarangiya kapungu.
Isussha anoo pakeeru, tputseetssha: Wirakuch Apanllish pshtumaam mbamcha; mang, tárangiya Isusu.
Napancha: kameechoo wanuts kapungu m'kushash wach pshtumaam pinasaku. Ashikpaz ashkiya wirak'cheewa Apanllish pshtumaam aranganasha mbama; tárangiya Isusu.
Tputssha: Maya, ashkachinaariya ashiru, ¿tamayarinaareezich kamungchich? mang, táranganaya.
Isussha: Chaanamuntari kamungumaam wanindaja; itaru Apanllina xaptareeja; mang, tárangiya Isusu.
Itaru, Pitorsha: Ichee, mazinangcha. Shiyamand kaminish maachiritaatsini kasarangtanicha. Amb ashkuni, ¿Apanlleema taárash waritcheeja? mang, tárangu,
Isussha: Aa, waritachparee, tárangu. Natumasamaam watsapunoo kasaku, wizanllee kasaku, zoonllee kasaku, waparee kasaku, wipaa kasaku, Apanll wamin ashkiya.

Tputs ashkinaari, Apanllsha nish tsapurunasush aranganash istachiya. Itaru, urutamarit Apanllush watsapunu taachinllinaya; mang, tárangiya Isusu. Ashiriya, yuwaa Apanllush pshtumaam mbamcha, tárangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus waanaatsi watsipunu kamanirangu anoo kamanchinllpa

Minush zari wipunasheetsimari 12 arapinlltama machtayaru, mang kamanirangiya. Mazinangandama, mang, tárangu. Nuw tputstana. Itaru, nuw Apanlltamana Ipusamarini. Apanllee kuk kamanimapan zitamin zapan wasina kamanirangana wirkarimuna. Apanll Ipusamarini ashtachu anoo kamanirangana. Natsha Irusarinap naakchuri, yuwaa kamanirangana anuri tuminchima.
Ichtaru, yaana kurakarini nuwaa putachinllinaya. Putayarusin, tunarip nuwaa zanganchinllinaya. Tunarsha nuwaa michitchinllinaya. Nuwaa stayarusin, kchishi kawacheersin,
pzkooyarusin, kizpur nuwaa kiyung yachachinllinaya. Sheersin, nuwaa pachachinllinaya. Izuuru tsipayaritaati, itaru zari tuchpashu yusur támchina, Isus mang, tárangiya wipunasheetsi.
Wipunashsha anoo mazinamana mazinarangitaatssin, itaru mang nda pakchiyam mangoonarangana. Mangooneeyi atitaatssin, mang xapoorangana. Na kamaneena yuwaa Isus waanaatsi watsipunu kamanirangu anootsi.
Mishat, Isus Irusarinap nattu, minush zar wach mchusaa yararangu anoo kamanchinllpa
Yaktash Jerico sura watsiritanacha, Isus tputsee mang chamayangarangiya wach mchusaatsi. Tputs kurik panapanda átu, uru ngootsish kuxinxinaw ashirangiya.
Tputs zapan zamamtarusin, mchussha masheeru, ¿Mayaatssha tputs wazapan zamamtaranaya? mang, tárangiya.
Tputssha: Isus naanchpa, Násaretshuchi, mang, tárangiya.
Wach mchusshacha: Isusoo, istanda, watam shiy Dapiyarinchichshawa, átar ashirangiya; tamundarangiya.
Tputssha mang nambku, Zamangi; tárangiya. Itaru, wach mchusshita nda sambaytarangiya; kizpur kuk zunganeerangiya, manga. Isusoo, nuwaa istangandama; tárangiya.
Isussha mazinayaru, xiyeeramchu, Yamashini; táyaru, tputssha mang itatarangiya wach mchusaatsi.
Kuseeru, Isussha: ¿Mayaamsha nuwaa kuruzuksha? ¿Tamanda átsha? táyaru, wach mchussha; Ichee, kachi yaranda; nappi átana; mang, tárangiya.
Isussha: Nuwamun mangish taturangush, ashiri napangi; átu,

uwsha musásiri napta ashirangiya. Wach mchusamunsha Apanllee: Wapparee, Apaa; shiy kizpurtishcha; táta táta ashirangiya. Isusushsha tachitarangiya; wipunasheem mang kinarangiya. Tputssha anoo pakeersin, ichinguru tputs Apanllee ungirtaranganaya, manga. Ashiri yuwaa Isus wach mchusaa yararangu anoo wapparee kamaneena.
